title: A map texture set's imported textures: res/field/maps/textures/<set>/imports.json
description: Textures of other map texture sets that this set gains, after its own, each its image and palette as the other set encodes them (tools/data/map_texture_data.py, nitro_texture_writer.py), so that a model moved to an area whose set lacks some of its textures keeps them. A copy of each PNG beside the set's own lets Blender show the model; the packer doesn't read it.

texture.description: The texture's name, as the other set has it
